briefing: Markets were flat-to-mixed today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P500 +0.3%), a neutral session rather than a clear risk-on signal. With cash well above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we filled two of them with the highest-scoring, most multi-signal-confirmed names (BOOT, KRMN) while keeping one slot and cash in reserve rather than fully deploying on a non-confirmatory day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD crossover happens when a stock's MACD line moves above its signal line, often signaling building upward momentum. Combined with rising histogram bars and price above the 20-day average, it's one of the stronger technical confirmations traders look for before entering a position, even on an otherwise quiet market day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD黃金交叉是指股票的MACD線向上穿越訊號線，通常代表上升動能正在形成。若再配合柱狀圖持續走高及股價站上20日均線，便是交易者在入市前較常參考的強力技術確認訊號，即使大盤當日表現平淡也是如此。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the Nasdaq dipping slightly and the S&P 500 edging higher, reflecting a lack of major new catalysts rather than any significant risk-on or risk-off shift. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer directional signals. No major market-moving headlines were identified in today's available news feed.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢大致持平，納指微跌、標普小升，反映市場缺乏重大新消息刺激，而非出現明顯的風險偏好轉變。交投維持區間震盪，投資者仍在等待更明確的方向訊號。今日未見可供引用的重大市場新聞標題。

trades.reasoning: Boot Barn shows a clean four-signal setup (bullish MACD crossover, rising histogram, RSI 63.5 in the healthy zone, price above SMA-20) in an established liquid name, fitting the open slot on a neutral-but-stable day.

KRMN has the same strong multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, rising histogram, RSI 66.9, price above SMA-20) and deploys idle cash per the risk rule while keeping conviction moderate since today is a neutral market day rather than a confirmed risk-on breakout.
